_decision: D-01: Frequency caps are SOFT targets (scoring penalties), not hard blocks. They never disqualify a dish — they only lower its suggestion score. User can always pick or swap to any dish regardless of frequency.

meal_structure._rule: HARD — every main meal (lunch, dinner) must have all five components. Engine must not generate a meal output missing any of these.

required_components.note: One carb source per meal — roti OR rice, never both
At least one protein item mandatory in every meal
One vegetable dish required — not optional, not substitutable with dal

required_sides.note: Simple fresh salad — always served, not swappable in v1
Curd or raita always on the side

frequency_caps.description: Chicken preferred at most 3 days a week — heavy score penalty beyond this, never blocked
Eggs preferred at most 4 days a week — score penalty beyond this, never blocked
Fish preferred 1 day a week — soft target, user can skip without any block

combination_blocks.description: Dal does not go with any non-veg item — chicken, fish, or egg curry in a meal means no dal in the same meal. Applies to both lunch and dinner.
Chole or rajma in a meal means no dal — they are both legumes and nutritionally redundant together

combination_blocks.rule: only one carb source per meal
combination_blocks.description: Either roti OR rice per meal, never both

carb_rules.description: Max 1.5 scoop rice (dry basis) at dinner

dinner_rules.description: Dinner must include a protein source — paneer, chicken, or fish mandatory
